Values: Values should specify a `line type in PyPSA <https://pypsa.readthedocs.io/en/latest/components.html#line-types>`_. Keys should specify the corresponding voltage level (e.g. 220., 300. and 380. kV)
Description: Specifies line types to assume for the different voltage levels of the TAMU Network.

N-1 derate of line capacities (`s_nom`) to approximate :math:`N-1` security and reserve capacity for reactive power flows; set as the lines' static ``s_max_pu`` (formerly ``lines.s_max_pu``). Hourly line ratings (``dynamic_line_rating``) multiply it independently.

Hourly line ratings for ``interconnect: usa`` with ``transmission_network: hifld`` and ``renewable_weather_years: [2012]``. ``true`` reads the dynamic ratings ``data/dlr_2012.csv``, ``false`` (default) the static ratings ``data/slr_2012.csv``, both downloaded from Zenodo record 24452558 (one column per base-network line, ~3.6 GB each) and aggregated onto the model branches by s_nom-weighted mean; dynamic ratings are capped at 1.3 on each base line before the aggregation (static ratings are not). Lines get ``s_max_pu = N1_derate * rating`` per hour, AC links of a transport model ``p_max_pu * rating``. Other setups keep the static ``N1_derate``.
Global upper limit for the maximum capacity of each extendable line.
Upper limit for the extended capacity of each extendable line.
Correction factor to account for the fact that buses are *not* connected by lines through air-line distance. Only used in TAMU network.

Price AC lines and HVDC links by the ReEDS county-pair route cost per great-circle km (region, terrain, detour). ``false`` uses the national ``HVAC overhead`` / ``HVDC overhead`` cost per km of ``length``. See :doc:`/data-costs`.

With ``regional_costs``, scale the AC line cost by voltage class, ``(kV/500)^b`` fitted to ReEDS ``rev_transmission_basecost.csv``. ``false`` (default) prices every line at 500 kV, as ReEDS does; ``true`` makes lines below 500 kV much dearer (x1.4 at 345 kV, x1.9 at 230 kV, x2.9 at 138 kV).

CSV of convex piecewise expansion costs per line, columns ``line,breakpoint,capital_cost`` with one row per segment. ``breakpoint`` is the segment's upper end in MW above the line's existing ``s_nom`` (``inf`` or empty for an unbounded last segment) and ``capital_cost`` its annualised cost per MW, in the units of the network's ``capital_cost`` and non-decreasing across segments. It replaces ``capital_cost`` for added capacity in the objective, per investment period, and in ``lc`` transmission limits; existing capacity keeps ``capital_cost``. Results in the line columns ``piecewise_expansion_cost`` and ``piecewise_expansion_cost_<period>``.

Static synchronous series compensators (SSSCs) on AC lines, built by the optimisation; needs pypsa-bill. An SSSC's series compensation ``q_sssc`` (MVAr) shifts its line's angle in the voltage law by ``-q_sssc / s_nom``. With several investment periods (perfect foresight) the SSSC capacity, its cost and ``max_pu`` apply per period. Results in the line columns ``sssc_nom_opt``, ``sssc_nom_<period>_opt`` and the series ``q_sssc``.
``true`` gives every AC line with a positive ``s_nom`` an extendable SSSC (``false`` by default).
Overnight SSSC cost per kW (kVAr) of rating (default 80).
Real discount rate for the annuity (default 0.036, as transmission lines).
Fixed O&M per year as a share of the overnight cost (default 0.015, as transmission). ``capital_cost_sssc = 1000 * capex * (annuity(lifetime, wacc_real) + fom_fraction)`` per MVAr and year.
Upper limit of the SSSC rating per unit of line capacity, ``sssc_nom <= max_pu * s_nom``, where ``s_nom`` is the line's capacity (in each investment period) if it is extendable (default 0.3).
